title: Opening of the session and consent form
summary: Riddick is unsure what he is to be ready for; Allen asks him to sign a permission form.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places

I've got a whole pocket full of questions here. Ah! Ah! Oh, you want to read that over and sign it? That's plenty enough for me. Okay, here, let me give you something to write on.
